observations: (a) Facilitator ending turns while seats ran (card 208 observation): no sign of it on this card. The gaps between commits while a seat ran are 38ff854 23:57:40Z to ab94601 23:59:03Z to b374ef7 00:07:43Z, and the facilitator's own commits follow the green within 70 seconds (fcffe85 00:07:34Z, 21b9cb5 00:08:10Z, 58e4b81 00:08:53Z). Git cannot show an ended turn, so this is 'not contradicted', not 'resolved'; the correction (block with capped waits in the same turn) stays standing and the watchdog stays the detector.

(b) Order-dependent test pollution (card 208 observation, the shared BACKENDS dict): not met on this card. The whole suite (311 OK, 7 skipped) ran once, clean; the acceptance fixture sets commit dates with mock.patch.dict(os.environ), which restores on exit, instead of editing shared state, and the red's guard MG0 shows the dating is real (renaming the env key makes it fail). The shared dict lives in mob-defaults and this repository's tests do not share one, so there is no evidence here for the template question; it stays with the retro. The criterion 2 forged-date guard and the held-record fixture are the next tests that set environment or repository state, so they use the same patch.dict helper.

(c) MOB.md staleness blocking a finished green: structural, not a one-off. The green's body: the check's only error was 'MOB.md is 6 non-MOB commits stale (maximum 3)', fixed by the facilitator's regeneration (fcffe85, 9 seconds before the green commit). Counting commits after the last regeneration (79e0892): 704bb02 in-flight, bca5510 intent, e4cda78 confirmation, 451f4ea red, 38ff854 in-flight, ab94601 unit = 6, three of them the facilitator's own and two of them D165's. A cycle always commits at least in-flight QA, red, in-flight developer, unit, green and record = 6 non-MOB commits, so with a maximum of 3 a seat cannot reach its green with a fresh MOB.md unless someone regenerates mid-cycle. Measured cost here was small (the regeneration came 9 seconds before the green commit), but the green's check was not rerun after the regeneration (92 GitHub calls, per the green body), so it was verified by the pre-push hook only; criterion 2 repeats the same commit pattern.

The red failed by assertion and named its run (74 tests, 1 failure), the unit layer was red against a stub rather than an import error, and the green carries four mutation runs (M1 5 failures, '<=' 6, not-in-history 1, own-commit unknown 1) and the whole suite once (311 OK). The green's check was not rerun after the regeneration. M6 (drop the previous-record comparison) could not be run and is open for criterion 2. Criterion 1 cannot say whether the card 208 fixture-list clause works because nothing broke.
stand_downs.adjustment: For criterion 2: keep MOB.md fresh by a fixed step, not by the failure. (1) The facilitator regenerates MOB.md when it launches the green seat (right after the red lands) and again when a green is reported, whatever the count, and prints 'MOB.md non-MOB commits since regeneration: n' in the seat-start in-flight line; the seat reruns the check once after any regeneration or states why it did not. (2) The D165 intent line and its confirmation go in one commit (criterion 2 reuses the card's intent line: the confirmation cites it, no second line unless the criterion's purpose differs). (3) An in-flight line is stamped with date -u run at the moment of the commit it rides in, and a suite run gets its own wait line citing its seat-start line. Metric: finished greens held by MOB.md staleness (criterion 1: 1; target 0); non-MOB commits since the last regeneration when the green is checked (criterion 1: 6; target 3 or fewer); in-flight stamps later than their own commit (criterion 1: 1 of 3; target 0). Counter-metrics: MOB.md regeneration commits per cycle (criterion 1: 2; more than 3 means regeneration is itself the churn) and red-to-green minutes (criterion 1: 10.7). The card 208 stand-down 2 clause also applies: the red for criterion 2 lists the existing tests it expects to change (the criterion 1 unit rows if the staged 'largest card number' choice goes) and runs tests.test_mob_process before the whole suite. The next probe is due by 00:37 UTC (50 minutes after the 23:47:10Z probe) before any seat starts.
